investigations.name: mcom-showcase
investigations.title: MCoM showcase: faithful phototroph-heterotroph community dynamics in process-bigraph
investigations.description:
Two studies exercise the same wrapped MCoM community (a single phytoplankton
and a single heterotroph coupled through DOC/DON pools and inorganic nitrogen)
under two contrasting environmental regimes, driven entirely by the clean-room
reproduction in viva_mcom.engine.
